description.value: A rustic log cabin-style pub on the Columbia Valley Highway near Cultus Lake, a popular recreational destination in the Fraser Valley. The kitchen turns out classic pub fare — chicken wings, burgers, poutine — alongside a cold beer and wine retail store, making it both a sit-down spot and a resupply point. Karaoke nights and pool tables give the place a lively local character that draws a broad mix of regulars and visitors.
